sources.snippet: Dia2-1B (Nari Labs, Apache-2.0) — a two-speaker dialogue text-to-speech model — re-authored to run on-device with LiteRT CompiledModel. Verified on a Pixel 8a (Tensor G3). Dia2 is a Moshi-style RQ-Transformer.

sources.title: GitHub - pk49800/pocket-tts · GitHub
sources.snippet: Pocket TTS A lightweight text-to-speech (TTS) application designed to run efficiently on CPUs. Forget about the hassle of using GPUs and web APIs serving TTS models. With Kyutai's Pocket TTS, generating audio is just a pip install and a function call away.
